g.text: High sensitivity, failed calibration → patient test not performed

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 11px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: The method sees a real haplotype imbalance when we inject one, but on healthy benchmark data it lights up one window in four.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 11px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: A detector that fires without signal cannot be pointed at a child, so Mosaic Rescue closed the gate.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 9px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
